chapter_title_en: The Return of the Seven Radiance Empyrean God
chapter_keywords: empyrean god formation vs karmic punishment deity
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 555: The Seven Radiance Empyrean God Returns to the Battlefield
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning unleashes his ultimate hidden card: the legendary Seven Radiance Empyrean God of the Starseizing Manor. The ancient War God clashes with the Three-Eyed Fiendgod in a battle that will decide the fate of the Crimsonbright Realmverse!
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 555: The Legend of the Starseizing Manor Returns
og_description: Ji Ning summons the Seven Radiance Empyrean God, a legendary War God from the primordial era. The battlefield shifts as a Daofather-tier power arrives to challenge the Seamless Gate's might.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 555: The cavalry has arrived!
twitter_description: Ji Ning's hidden ace is revealed! The Seven Radiance Empyrean God, spear in hand, slaughters a path toward the Three-Eyed Fiendgod. The tide of the Realm War is about to change.

lore_anchors.definition: A colossal battle avatar formed by the fusion of seven ancient Empyrean Gods from the Starseizing Manor, commanded by the legendary Bloodfire Empyrean God.
The legendary number one War God of the Starseizing Manor, famous for his snowflake-adrift, spear-wielding fighting style. He was a peerless figure from the primordial era.
A powerful battle formation formed by the three great demon gods of Devouring Mountain (the Nine-Headed Lion, the Golden-Furred Divine Eagle, and the Broken-Horned Divine Dragon).
A dragon-shaped war formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, capable of devastating coordinated attacks.
Colossal battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
Battle puppets formed by Celestial Immortals dissolving their formation and reassembling into smaller, individually more powerful combat units.
The ancient age of myth in the Desolate Era cosmos, before the current established order, when the Human Race and Fiendgods battled for supremacy.
The ancient, broken home of Daoist Threelives and his legendary retainer, the Bloodfire Empyrean God. Its legacy is Ji Ning's hidden ace.
